DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for a map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。スマホの電池が二パーセントしかありません。出口は画面で見ていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 電池不足で地図が使えなくなると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My phone battery is only at two percent. I was checking the exit on the screen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that low battery will make the map unavailable. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙の案内図をお渡しします。今いる所はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here is a paper guide map. You are here now.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。充電できる場所を探して歩き回る前に、帰り道を知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 充電探しより帰路確認を優先する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. Before walking around looking for a charging point, I want to know the way back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Prioritize checking the return route over finding a charger. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この園路をまっすぐ進めば入口へ戻れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Follow this park path straight ahead to return to the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 曲がり角が二つありますが、どちらも道なりでよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曲がり角での進み方を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: There are two bends. Should I follow the path around both?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to proceed at the bends. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。分かれ道では入口の標識を選んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. At forks, follow the signs for the entrance.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙にその目印を丸で囲みます。電話は迎えの連絡用に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 紙地図に目印を残し電池用途を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will circle that landmark on the paper. I will save the phone for contacting my pickup.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Mark the paper map and decide what to save the battery for. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 管理棟で必要な案内もできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: The management building can also provide any guidance you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 連絡だけ済ませ、地図は紙で見ます。今日は周回をやめて入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 必要な連絡後に入口へ戻る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will just make the necessary contact and use the paper map. I will stop my circuit today and return to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return to the entrance after making the necessary contact. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。分からなくなったら、表示の前で係員へお尋ねください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11239-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. If you get confused, ask a staff member by a sign.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 走らずこちらへどうぞ。何をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please come here without running. What are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 前の列車に傘を忘れました。今なら追い掛けて乗れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 発車列車の忘れ物を追いたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my umbrella on the previous train. Can I still catch up and board it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you want to chase a departed train for a forgotten item. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 出発した列車を追わず、忘れ物の窓口へ情報を伝えましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Rather than chase a train that has departed, give the information to the lost-property counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 青い傘で、最後尾の座席の横に掛けました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 傘と車内位置を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: It is a blue umbrella, which I hung beside the seats at the very back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the umbrella and its location inside the train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 乗った時刻と行先を覚えていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you remember the boarding time and destination?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 十時の列車で、券の記録はこれです。乗換の時間も気になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 乗車時刻行先と乗換予定を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It was the ten o'clock train, and here is the ticket record. I am also worried about my connection time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the boarding time, destination information, and connection plans. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 忘れ物の対応を待つか、先へ進んで後で連絡するかお考えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Consider whether to wait for the lost-property process or continue your journey and contact us later.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 仕事に遅れるので、情報を伝えたら次の列車に乗ります。照会番号をもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 先へ移動し後で照会する方法を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will be late for work, so after giving the information I will take the next train. Can I have an inquiry number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Choose to continue and inquire later. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受付の控えをご案内します。回収できるとの保証ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will explain the acknowledgment slip. This does not guarantee recovery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えを受け取り、仕事の後に照会します。ホームを走って戻るのはやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えを保管し走って追わないと決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will take the slip and inquire after work. I will not run back along the platform to chase it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Keep the slip and decide not to run after the train. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。乗換は余裕を持ってお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please allow enough time for your transfer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 期限の通知についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about an expiry notice, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この通知は来月までですが、カードには来年の日付があります。どちらを予定表に書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通知とカードに異なる期限があると示し記録する日付を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. This notice says next month, but the card has a date next year. Which should I put in my calendar?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Show the different notice and card deadlines and ask which date to record. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この通知の見出しは、電子証明書となっていますね。カード本体の期限とは分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The heading on this notice says electronic certificate. We will check it separately from the card itself's expiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: カードが来年までなら、来月の通知は無視してよいと思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本体期限が後なら通知を無視できると思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought I could ignore next month's notice if the card was valid until next year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you thought a later card expiry meant the notice could be ignored. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それぞれの期限で、必要な手続きや利用できる機能を担当が確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: The staff will check the procedures needed and functions available for each expiry date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先に通知の対象を確かめたいです。カードを作り直す申込みと同じ物だと決めずに相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通知の対象を確認しカード再発行と同じ手続きだと決めないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I would like to confirm what the notice covers first. I will ask without assuming it is the same as applying to remake the card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the notice's subject without assuming the procedure is card reissuance. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。通知とカードを、担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Please show the notice and card to the staff responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 両方持ってきました。予定表には、電子証明書は来月、カード本体は来年と別々に記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 通知とカードを提示し二つの期限を別に記録すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I brought both. I will record them separately in my calendar: electronic certificate next month, card itself next year.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show both and say you will record the two deadlines separately. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その区別で伺います。利用のご予定はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We will handle them with that distinction. Are you planning to use it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 再来週に電子の申請をする予定です。その時に使えるかと、必要な手続きの時期を確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 電子申請の予定日を示し利用可否と手続き時期の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I plan to make an electronic application the week after next. I would like to check whether it can be used then and when the required procedure should be done.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State your electronic application timing and ask about usability and procedure timing. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つの期限と申請の予定を担当へ伝え、手続きについてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will tell the staff both expiry dates and your application plans, and explain the procedure.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: この家族歴の欄について確認してもよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: May I check this family medical history field?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 私が子供の頃にかかった病気を書きました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 本人の病歴を家族欄へ書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I wrote an illness I had as a child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you entered your own medical history in the family field. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご本人の病歴は別の欄です。家族の病気について尋ねています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Your own history belongs in a different field. This asks about your family's illnesses.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 父母の病気ということですか。父の詳しい病名は知りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 父母の意味と父の病名不明を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: Does that mean my parents' illnesses? I do not know my father's exact diagnosis.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check that it means your parents and state your father's diagnosis is unknown. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 分からないことは推測せず、不明として伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do not guess what you do not know; report it as unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 父は通院していますが、病名は不明と書きます。母のことは確認できています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 知る通院事実と不明病名を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: My father attends medical appointments, but I will write that the diagnosis is unknown. I have confirmed my mother's information.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Distinguish the known fact of treatment from the unknown diagnosis. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当が詳しく伺います。ご本人の記載は既往歴へ移しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff will ask in detail. Let's move your own entry to past medical history.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 自分の病気をそちらへ移します。父の情報が分かったら後で追加できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自分の記載を移し追加方法を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move my illness there. Can I add my father's information later once I know it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Move your own entry and ask how to add information. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 看護師にお伝えいただけます。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 家族に確認してから追加します。今は分かる範囲だけでお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 確認できる範囲のみ申告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will add it after checking with my family. For now, please use only what I know.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report only the information you can confirm. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。不明な点も含め担当へ引き継ぎます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will pass it to the staff, including what remains unknown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: どのような料金の請求でしたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: What kind of charge was demanded?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 動画サービスの未払いだそうです。今日中に払わないと問題になると言われました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 期限を迫る料金電話を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: An unpaid video-service fee, apparently. They said there would be trouble if I did not pay today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the fee-demand call pressuring you with a deadline. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: そのサービスを契約した心当たりはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you remember subscribing to that service?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 名前は知っていますが、契約した記録はありません。電話では番号を聞けませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 契約心当たりと記録の欠如を答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I know the name, but have no subscription record. I could not ask for the number during the call.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: State your recollection of a subscription and the lack of records. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: まだです。急がされて怖くなりましたが、家の契約記録を確認してから来ました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未払いで先に契約記録を確認したと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not yet. The pressure frightened me, but I checked my subscription records at home before coming here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you have not paid and first checked your subscription records. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 相手が述べた金額や時刻を記録していますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you recorded the amount they stated and the time?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三万円、今朝十時です。私の記録にないからと断定せず、正規窓口でも確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金額時刻を示し正式確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thirty thousand yen, at ten this morning. I do not want to conclude based only on its absence from my records; I want to check through the official contact too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the amount and time and request formal verification. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 電話の相手が指定した窓口だけに頼らず、公式の連絡先を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Do not rely only on the contact specified by the caller; check the official contact details.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 既知の公式サイトから調べます。確認前に相手の指示で送金しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 正規窓口で確認まで送金を保留する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will look through the official website I already know. I will not send money on the caller's instructions before checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Hold off payment until checking through the official contact. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。請求内容と実際の契約状況を分けて伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will ask separately about the demand and the actual subscription status.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 宛先に部屋番号がありませんが、一戸建てですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: There is no room number in the address. Is it a detached house?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: いいえ。友人のマンションです。建物名があれば届くと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 建物名のみの宛先を書いたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: No. It is my friend's apartment building. I thought the building name would be enough for delivery.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you wrote only the building name in the address. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 同じ建物に複数の部屋があります。宛先を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are multiple apartments in the same building. Please confirm the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人に聞きます。本人の名前だけで部屋を探してもらうのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 受取人へ確認する意向を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will ask my friend. I want to avoid making the delivery staff search for the room from the person's name alone.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you intend to check with the recipient. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認できるまで受付をお待ちできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can hold off acceptance until you confirm it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四〇五と返事が来ました。ただ、友人の書き方は四階五号室となっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 曖昧な階室表記の返事を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: They replied 405. But my friend wrote it as fifth room on the fourth floor.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the ambiguous floor-and-room wording in the reply. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 指定された宛先の表記を、そのまま正しく書いてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please accurately write the specified address exactly as given.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 聞き直したら、部屋番号は四〇五でした。建物名の後に加えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正式な部屋番号を聞き直して追記する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I asked again, and the room number is 405. I will add it after the building name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask again for the formal room number and add it. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。数字を再確認してください。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 四〇五と読めるよう書きました。返送先の自分の部屋番号も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先と返送先の部屋番号を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written it clearly as 405. I will also check my own room number in the return address.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Check the room numbers in the destination and return addresses. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 両方の住所を確認して受付します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will check both addresses before accepting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの画面についてですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: This is about the transfer screen, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。受付完了とあるので、今日もう相手へ届いたと伝えてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約受付の表示で相手へ着金したと言えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It says acceptance complete. Can I tell the recipient it has already arrived today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether acceptance of a scheduled transfer means you may say the funds arrived. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この画面は振込予約ですね。実行予定日はいつになっていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: This screen is a scheduled transfer. What is its planned execution date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 来週の月曜です。今日は金曜なので、今すぐ送ったこととは違うんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 翌週実行予定を読み今日の即時送金とは違うと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Next Monday. Today is Friday, so it is different from sending immediately today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Read the following week's execution date and distinguish it from an immediate transfer today. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 受付の状態と、実際の実行結果を分けて確認する必要があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: You need to check acceptance status separately from the actual execution result.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 相手には、月曜実行の予約を受け付けたとだけ伝えます。届いたという言い方はやめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手へ予約受付という現在の状態だけ伝えると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will only say the transfer scheduled for Monday has been accepted. I will stop saying it has arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will tell the recipient only the current scheduled-transfer acceptance status. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。予約の内容と、実行後の結果をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Check the scheduled details and the result after execution.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: もう一度今すぐ振り込めば確実だと思いましたが、二重になるかもしれないので追加の操作は待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 追加の即時振込は二重になり得るため操作を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I thought another immediate transfer would ensure it, but that might duplicate the payment, so I will wait before making any additional operation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will wait because an additional immediate transfer could duplicate payment. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の振込みをする前に、今の予約の扱いを担当へ確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Before another transfer, ask the staff how the existing schedule should be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この予約画面で相談します。相手から未着と連絡があっても、新しい振込みを先に出さず、予約の状態を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未着の連絡が来ても既存予約を確認してから対応すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will ask using this scheduled-transfer screen. Even if the recipient says it has not arrived, I will check the schedule's status before initiating a new transfer.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check the existing schedule before acting even after a nonreceipt report. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。受付済みの予約内容を拝見し、変更や確認に必要な手順をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We will look at the accepted schedule and explain the steps needed for changes or confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計後のことでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about something after checkout?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。この袋を自分のだと思って取りましたが、持ち手の色が違います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持ち手違いで取り違え疑いを申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I took this bag thinking it was mine, but the handle color is different.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Report a possible bag mix-up based on the different handle. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中の品物は動かしましたか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだです。自分の袋には黄色いタグを付けています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 未操作と識別タグを答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Not yet. My own bag has a yellow tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you have not handled the contents and give the identifying tag. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋をこちらへ置いてください。ほかのお客様の物か確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please put the bag here. We will check whether it belongs to another customer.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。勝手に中を広げず、自分のレシートで品物も照合したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 中身を広げずレシート照合を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Without spreading the contents out myself, I would also like to match the items against my receipt.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask to check against your receipt without spreading out the contents. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お客様の袋はこちらにありました。黄色いタグが付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Your bag was here. It has a yellow tag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: こちらですね。レシートにはパンと牛乳があります。入れた品も自分で確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 見つかった袋を購入品と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: This one, correct? My receipt lists bread and milk. I will check the items I put inside too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Match the found bag with your purchases. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認が取れたら、ご自身の袋だけお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once confirmed, please take only your own bag.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。似た袋は置いたまま、黄色いタグの方を持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人の袋だけ確認後持ち帰る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have confirmed it. I will leave the similar bag where it is and take home the one with the yellow tag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Take home only your own bag after checking. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。お忘れ物にお気を付けください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. Please take care not to leave anything behind.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: そのロープの内側は、今は入れません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: You cannot go inside that rope at the moment.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 写真を撮るだけでもだめですか。「養生中」の意味が分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 養生表示の意味と撮影の可否を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Not even just to take a photo? I do not understand “under restoration.”
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what the restoration sign means and whether photography is allowed. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 芝生を回復させるため、踏まないようにしている区画です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: This area is kept free of foot traffic to let the lawn recover.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そういう意味なんですね。ロープをまたがず、こちらで止まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: ロープ外で止まると応じる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: So that is what it means. I will stop here without stepping over the rope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Agree to stop outside the rope. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 園路からなら、芝生を背景に撮れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: From the path, you can take a photo with the lawn in the background.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人が通れるように端へ寄ります。友人には内側で立ってもらわない方がいいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者も園路に留まる必要を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will move to the edge so people can pass. My friend should not stand inside either, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm that your companion also needs to remain on the path. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。お二人とも園路から撮影してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Correct. Both of you should photograph from the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ここから横向きに撮れば入れそうです。草を踏まずに構図を変えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 踏まずに画角を変える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: If I take it horizontally from here, it should fit. I will change the composition without stepping on the grass.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change the camera angle without stepping on the grass. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 通行の方が来たら、撮影を一度止めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: When someone comes through, please pause your photography.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。一枚撮って道を空けます。散歩もロープの外を回ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通行時に撮影を止め園路で散歩する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will take one photo and clear the way. I will also walk around outside the rope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Pause photos for passersby and walk on the path. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。園路をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11240-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please use the path.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 駅前のバス停への道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the way to the bus stop outside the station?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。北側へ行くので、この地図の上へ進めばよいですよね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 図の上へ進めば北へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I am going north, so I should head toward the top of this map, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether moving toward the map's top takes you north. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 方位の矢印をご覧ください。この図では右が北になっています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Look at the direction arrow. On this map, north is to the right.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 地図はいつも上が北だと思っていました。今、私は図のどこにいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図の向きの思い込みを伝え現在地を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought north was always at the top of maps. Where am I on this one now?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain your assumption about map orientation and ask your current location. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この出口の印です。実際の出口と、図にある広場を比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: At this exit mark. Compare the actual exit with the plaza on the map.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 目の前の時計台が、この広場の中央ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 目の前の時計台と図の広場を照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: The clock tower in front of me is in the center of this plaza, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Match the clock tower before you with the plaza on the map. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。バス停へは、時計台の右側の通路を進みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. For the bus stop, take the passage to the right of the clock tower.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙の上下だけで決めず、時計台を見て右へ進むんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 現地の時計台を基準に右へ進むと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: So I should use the clock tower and go right, rather than decide from the top and bottom of the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm going right using the actual clock tower as reference. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その先の案内にも、バス停の表示があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: There are also bus-stop signs in the guidance ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 方位と現在地が分かりました。時計台の右を通り、バス停の表示も確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 方位と目印を合わせ表示で経路を確かめると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I understand the directions and current location now. I will pass to the right of the clock tower and check the bus-stop signs too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will combine directions and landmarks and verify the route with signs. Please say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい。図の向きと現地の目印を合わせてお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-11241-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes. Match the map's orientation to the landmarks on site as you go.
